subject.title: fix(agents): keep bundle LSP tool names provider-safe

question: Should bundled LSP registration intentionally rename previously unsafe, overlong, or colliding generated tool names while preserving every already-valid complete name?
rationale: The repair is technically coherent, but only maintainers can accept the upgrade effect on provider-specific allowlists or policies that may reference generated names which were previously accepted by a less strict provider.

options.title: Accept bounded renaming
options.body: Merge with the current rule because unchanged valid names retain compatibility and only unusable or ambiguous generated names are repaired.

options.title: Require an upgrade note
options.body: Keep the implementation but require explicit PR-body guidance that policies matching repaired generated names may need updating.

options.title: Pause the change
options.body: Do not merge until maintainers define a different permanent cross-provider naming contract shared with bundled MCP tooling.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded renaming
recommendation.body: Merge with the current rule because unchanged valid names retain compatibility and only unusable or ambiguous generated names are repaired.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent agent-runtime ownership and explicit routing in the PR timeline make this account the strongest available decision owner.
